title: Hutterite German
description: Upper German dialect spoken by Hutterites in North America
extract: Hutterite German is an Upper German dialect of the Bavarian variety of the German language, which is spoken by Hutterite communities in Canada and the United States. Hutterite is also called Tirolean, but this is an anachronism.
